scenario: A packaged Candidate reopened a real completed Russian-to-English translation created by the prior accepted Process route and materialized its managed text without a provider invocation.
assertions: The result is a managed UTF-8 TXT derived only from persisted translation JSON and matching Integra provenance.
Project, source identifier, transcript hash, subtitle hash, translation hash, requested language and executed language bind before materialization.
The normal Results card uses the existing Open and Export controls; raw translation JSON remains technical data.
Reopening an accepted legacy translation does not rerun translation and preserves its original translation JSON.
limitations: This outcome exposes readable translated TXT only; it does not add translated SRT, topic translation, another language, semantic acceptance, Stage B, Knowledge or Studio work.
Translation remains a review-required machine result.
